G-A043, G-A048 and G-A049 left the same anchor in the same direction and all failed their internal gate; that is recorded here, not argued away.

The candidate -1.375 is inside that band and weaker than both the deployed start and the Isaac Lab value.
external_reference.departure_reason: The role is a body-frame vertical-velocity penalty (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py: torch.square(asset.data.root_lin_vel_b[:, 2])). On this baseline it is measured at five walking values. The rough side-step posture falls were 59 / 80 / 24 / 16 / 46 at -2.0 / -1.75 / -1.5 / -1.25 / -1.0 and the G3 score 4.23 / 1.41 / 7.41 / 8.98 / 4.59 (reports/evidence/go2_axis_bottleneck_four_arms_20260927/AXIS_BOTTLENECK_FOUR_ARMS.csv and reports/evidence/go2_g_a048_readout_20260926/DIAL_FOUR_POINTS.csv). Only -1.5 and -1.25 raised G3 and both kept the stairs inside the g3_guard_margin_v1 limits; -1.375 lies between them. It is a search position, not an optimum estimate.
external_reference.literature: R-Sci-4 (Hwangbo 2019) discounts every penalty except the objective term by a curriculum coefficient that starts at 0.3 - lowering one penalty weight is the same direction as that discount. The principle transfers; the number does not (different robot, different dt), and this run applies the smaller weight from iteration 0 rather than annealing it.

single_change.name: lin_vel_z_l2
single_change.applied_by: tools/build_go2_a033_reward_package.py renders the arm ZIP's candidate reward file from the deployed template with this value; the reference copy beside it keeps -2.0 and the two differ in that one line, which the builder checks line by line.

value_derivation.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using an L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1, reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py: torch.square(asset.data.root_lin_vel_b[:, 2])). It is the body frame's vertical speed squared - not foot height, not world-frame altitude, not ground clearance. On a slope the body frame tilts with the robot, so the same climb charges differently there than on flat ground.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A033 walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.151 at -1.375 (go2_reward_mechanism.spec_margin over reports/evidence/go2_reward_mechanism_20260917/, zone WALK, range_status BETWEEN_OBSERVED). The stop zone's top is +0.0155. A margin is reward arithmetic over measured postures and is not a ranking basis (reports/GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md section 8).
value_derivation.situations: spec_margin situations at -1.375: climb +0.0322, sway -0.0587, push -0.0482. At -1.25 the same arithmetic predicted losses on sway and all four push directions and every one came out a gain (reports/evidence/go2_g_a048_readout_20260926/FORECAST_CHECK.csv). The cells are carried as a record, not as a prediction this arm relies on.
value_derivation.rule: -1.375 is the midpoint of the two measured values that raised G3 on this baseline (-1.5 and -1.25). The midpoint is an operational search position between two observations with different weaknesses (G2 combined right turn at -1.5, none at -1.25); it is not proven better than -1.4 or -1.35.
value_derivation.not_claimed: No score gain is estimated. A044 (-1.75), the midpoint of -2.0 and -1.5, was worse than both ends on every fall counter, so a midpoint does not inherit its neighbours' performance. One training seed cannot separate the value's effect from a different training path. The G3 target is chosen from the scoring arithmetic, not from a prediction that this value raises G3 further than G-A048.

preregistered.source: fact_rules_v1 with every G-A049 threshold unchanged AND the plan screening edition g3_guard_margin_v1 (tools/go2_screening_gate.py, workspace/training/quadruped/upload/plan/GO2_G3_FIRST_20260927.md section 3). Combined locally by tools/verify_go2_basic_motion_harvest.py. There is no server gate. The hypothesis block below is a separate readout and gates nothing.
preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended, and UNCHANGED from G-A048 (and G-A044, G-A043) on purpose for fact_rules_v1 - no adoption threshold moves after any result; the plan screening edition is g3_guard_margin_v1, preregistered before this arm (user decision G-D-G3-FIRST-20260927). tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. Each non-flat scenario may lose at most twice its own sd; flat G1/G2 use max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop 2x0.28229/10.5 = 0.054 and max_flat_case_survival_drop 2 robots of 32 - the limit that actually caught G-A043's combined_yaw_right at all three seeds. The group floors and the climbed-robot floors are G-A043's, recomputed from the same stored G-A033 records for the same groups. None of these limits carries training-seed noise: every training in the project used seed 42, so they are lower bounds.

target_group_roles.stairs: a scored group of fact_rules_v1, carried unchanged (criterion 1 counts it with rough and push). It is not the plan's target and carries no hypothesis in this run: the plan screening g3_guard_margin_v1 only protects the stairs, and the 15 cm count is recorded. Three seeds of the 10 cm case (A017 -> A033 at 900/900 took the climbed-robot count 28 -> 90 ge1 and 2 -> 43 ge2 of 96). Historical note: earlier arms of this dial read this group as the vertical-penalty hypothesis; that reading does not apply here.
target_group_roles.rough: the plan's target (G3 4.22726 of 14.0 at baseline, bound by rough_lateral survival; reports/evidence/go2_axis_bottleneck_four_arms_20260927/AXIS_BOTTLENECK_FOUR_ARMS.csv). the axis with the largest recoverable deduction (G3 4.22726 of 14.0, survival-1.0 counterfactual 10.71746, reports/GO2_AXIS_BOTTLENECK.md) and the axis this change is predicted to cost through the sway cell. rough_lateral is where a bouncier landing would show first.
target_group_roles.push: the disturbance guard and the second predicted loss. push_pos_x is G6's binding case and it is bound by survival (reports/GO2_AXIS_BOTTLENECK.md). A body allowed to move vertically for less cost may be thrown further by the same shove.

required_records.terrain_level_at_pin: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION: terrain at 700/800/900/999. Curriculum changes may mediate the total effect of the single weight; they do not alone invalidate that comparison. Direct mechanism and generalization remain unresolved; mean terrain is not saturation.
required_records.climb_counts: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions): 10cm and 15cm pooled ge1 and ge2 each >= baseline; at least one of the four strictly increases. Existing fact_rules_v1 guards also apply. tools/go2_climb_count.py; both heights seed101/202/303.
required_records.stairs_forward_distance: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions): for each of stairs_10_down and stairs_15_down, median seed delta of projected_progress_m > 0. Baseline and candidate use the same evaluator/registry and iteration900.
required_records.stall_time_share: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A PLAN SCREENING CRITERION UNDER g3_guard_margin_v1 (the stairs are protected by posture falls and tracking only; this was a criterion in earlier editions) (plan section 4 item 2). The share of time, before the first termination, in which the commanded-direction projected speed stays under 0.05 m/s for at least one continuous second, with the first 0.5 s and the terminal row excluded; null with a reason when the valid time is zero. Computed by tools/go2_stall_diagnostics.py for both arms with the same rule. The threshold is a design value, not a measured one. Both heights require median seed delta < 0 with simultaneous survival protection.
required_records.first_step_time: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION (plan section 4 item 3). The first timestamp at which the existing >=1 step climb rule fires, per robot, with non-arrivals recorded as null and censored=true. The mean over arrivals may not be reported as an improvement without the arrival rate beside it.
required_records.fall_channel_split: REQUIRED RECORD. The candidate rough_lateral and stairs falls must be split into the height channel and the tilt channel the way tools/go2_a038_reread.py split G-A033's (reports/evidence/go2_a038_reread_20260919/FALL_CHANNEL_ROLLUP.csv). This dial does not charge attitude at all, so a G3 loss is expected to arrive as a base contact rather than as a tilt.
required_records.push_both_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING PROTECTION under g3_guard_margin_v1 (the four-direction rule in push_all_directions covers push_pos_x and push_neg_x). Earlier editions judged these two directions with zero allowed loss and survival-median checks (post_a042_push_v1); this run does not.
required_records.push_all_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING PROTECTION under g3_guard_margin_v1. For push_pos_x, push_neg_x, push_pos_y and push_neg_y SEPARATELY: pooled posture falls over the three seeds <= baseline + 3, and the per-seed median tracking delta >= -0.01 (1e-9 tolerance). There is no survival-median check. The allowed losses are post_a048_guard_margin_v1's, unchanged. Earlier verdicts keep their own editions (zero allowed loss under post_a043_push4_v1) and reproduce byte for byte.
required_records.g2_combined_yaw_both_directions: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A NEW CRITERION (plan section 9-2). combined_yaw_left and combined_yaw_right are measured at all three seeds - which the full collection gives automatically - and filmed on both arms at seed 101. The judgement that catches a loss there is the EXISTING max_flat_case_survival_drop of 0.0625, which already fired on G-A043's three seeds. No new judgement code is written for G2; what changes is that the case can no longer be missed by the collection or absent from the video set.

preregistered.mechanism_readout: Two verdicts, reported separately and never merged (workspace/training/quadruped/upload/plan/GO2_G3_FIRST_20260927.md section 3). ADOPTION: fact_rules_v1 plus g3_guard_margin_v1 against the stored G-A033; a partial collection makes adoption INCONCLUSIVE. HYPOTHESIS: preregistered.hypothesis, two indicators read by tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py, each reported on its own, plus one recorded counter that is not judged there (the stairs are judged as adoption protection). A supported hypothesis with a failed adoption is not promoted; mixed results keep per-indicator verdicts and trigger no automatic rerun. REQUIRED DISCLOSURE: the readout reports the candidate's deltas against G-A048 as well as G-A033 - total, every scenario G1-G7, rough side-step, both stair heights, the four push directions and combined_yaw_right - and states any loss against G-A048 plainly; G-A048 is not an adoption baseline and no new threshold is made from it. A PASS under g3_guard_margin_v1 is a pass of a smaller check set (no stairs-improvement or stall block) and is not reported as progress by itself: progress is claimed only from the measured deltas above.
preregistered.video: human reading; the verifier reports VIDEO_UNKNOWN

plan_screening.inherits: post_a048_guard_margin_v1's protection block unchanged (fourteen checks, same allowed losses, tolerance 1e-9, no survival-median checks). The stairs-improvement and stall blocks are dropped as in g3_guard_push4_v1, because this run targets G3 and only protects the stairs. Earlier editions keep their code path, so every stored verdict is reproduced byte for byte.
plan_screening.combination: artifact/fingerprint validity first; fact_rules_v1 AND g3_guard_margin_v1; missing data overrides performance as INCONCLUSIVE
plan_screening.partial_coverage: Any missing environment or missing protection case makes screening INCONCLUSIVE; keep valid observations without promotion.
plan_screening.known_properties: the protection block is post_a048_guard_margin_v1's, so conditional on the stored G-A033 sample: 0.519 false-failure rate for a candidate from the same empirical distribution, 0.035 mean miss rate over the defined harms. Not a server re-run error rate. The edition was chosen after G-A048 was observed.

preregistered.rule_source: reports/GO2_STAIRS_BEHAVIOR_ANALYSIS_20260916.md 8-3b (target G3 G5, guard G1 G2 G4 G6 G7) and 8-4 (stairs measured by climbed robots); gap found by reports/GO2_G_A038_READOUT.md section 4

climb_guard.omitted: stairs_15_climb_ge1 is left out on purpose. Its baseline sum is 4 robots over three seeds and its measured max_drop is 5.523, so its floor is -1.523 and no result can violate it. tools/go2_fact_rules.py calls that inoperable and raises it as a violation rather than passing it silently (defect S-2, 2026-09-19). The 15 cm climb is still measured in stage 1 as a required record and judged by the local plan screening, which compares the pooled counts and the per-seed progress directly; it is not a gate here because at this sample size it cannot be one.

hypothesis.statement: At lin_vel_z_l2 -1.375 the rough side-step posture falls stay at or below the line reached by the two G3 points -1.5 and -1.25; whether the G2 combined-turn posture cost of -1.5 appears is recorded. The 15 cm stairs are recorded here and judged only as adoption protection.

rough_lateral_posture_falls.basis: the same line as G-A048's and G-A049's: 41 is about half-way between the baseline 59 and G-A043's 24. It is an operational criterion, not a statistical or official one, and it changes no adoption threshold.

yaw_right_posture_cost.basis: G-A043 (-1.5) fell at all three seeds (9, 9, 11); G-A033, G-A044, G-A047, G-A048 and G-A049 at none. Read as occurrence on the candidate only; the baseline G-A033 had 0 at every seed. One seed only is INSUFFICIENT.

hypothesis.edge_rule: Avoiding falsification is not support: a value just inside a boundary (for example 58 rough side-step falls) is INSUFFICIENT, as the thresholds already say.
decisions: adoption PASS (fact_rules_v1 + g3_guard_margin_v1): candidate review - videos, self-assessment and the deltas against G-A048 (a pass of a reduced check set is not progress by itself); the training-seed replicate waits on U2; no automatic long training.
rough SUPPORTED, adoption FAIL: re-compare the next candidate by the failed axis; no automatic bisection of the same interval.
rough NOT_SUPPORTED or INSUFFICIENT: close the single-term lin_vel_z search - no small numeric retry; the next candidate comes from another lever's fall-behaviour evidence or the U2 replicate.
yaw cost PRESENT: record it next to the adoption verdict; the G2 non-inferiority of fact_rules_v1 already judges its score effect.
missing or invalid artifacts: no performance conclusion; recover what is recoverable.

stairs_15_ge2.basis: recorded, not judged by the hypothesis: this run targets G3; the stairs are judged as protection cases by g3_guard_margin_v1. 15 cm ge2 was 0 / 0 / 77 / 24 / 1 across the five measured values.

why: Purpose: raise G3 (rough terrain), where about 5 of the remaining points sit, and keep the stairs, push, flat axes and G2. Not a promise of a higher score.

Role first (Isaac Lab formula): lin_vel_z_l2 pays -w * v_z^2 in the body frame, with no direction term, so the rise a tread requires is charged at the same rate as the bounce a bad landing produces. That is the mechanism this arm moves, and it is a property of the formula.

What is measured: at -2.0 / -1.75 / -1.5 / -1.25 / -1.0 the total was 42.53 / 38.89 / 44.62 / 50.16 / 46.20, rough side-step posture falls 59 / 80 / 24 / 16 / 46, G3 4.23 / 1.41 / 7.41 / 8.98 / 4.59 and combined_yaw_right falls 0 / 0 / 29 / 0 / 0. Every counter is non-monotone.
Why -1.375: the midpoint of the only two values that raised G3 (-1.5, -1.25); both kept the stairs inside the protection limits. A044 shows a midpoint can be worse than both ends.

Two verdicts, fixed before the run: adoption under fact_rules_v1 plus g3_guard_margin_v1 (stairs protected, not required to improve) and the hypothesis indicators (rough side-step falls <= 41 supported / >= 59 not; combined_yaw_right falls at >= 2 seeds = cost present). Neither verdict rescues the other.
Collection is G-A049's: all 69 cases in one pass, both combined-turn directions and all four push directions filmed on the candidate, every baseline counterpart reused by SHA.

notes.comparison_validity: Same seed 42, 4096 envs, 1000 iterations, evaluator and registry SHA as the stored G-A033 arm, evaluated at the same checkpoint iteration 900. The only difference is lin_vel_z_l2. G-A044, G-A043, G-A048 and G-A049 are four more points on the same dial under the same conditions.
notes.not_claimed: No score gain is promised and no improvement is predicted. One training seed cannot separate the value's effect from a different training path.
notes.deployed_list: lin_vel_z_l2 is item 3 of the six names in the deployed quadruped_rewards.py REWARD_WEIGHTS list, so this arm replaces a number rather than adding a line and go2_task/_finalize.py counts it as a participant reward change.
notes.deployed_prose_disagrees: The deployed file annotates the strong side of this dial with '강하게 (예 -3.0): 몸을 낮게 깔고 안정 (험지/계단 유리, 대신 굼뜸)' and warns that the weak side '-0.3 처럼 약하게' makes the robot bounce, slip on landing and lose posture on rough ground. G-A043 measured the opposite on the rough axes - rough side-step posture falls fell 59 -> 24 of 96 - so the file's warning is not confirmed there. Where G-A043 did lose posture was the flat combined turn, which the file does not mention.
notes.knowledge_doc_policy: MASTER section 1-a records every measured point of this dial as rejected by its internal gate; this arm adds a pending row. Past rows are not rewritten.
notes.curriculum_lag: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION: terrain at 700/800/900/999. At iteration 900 G-A033 4.49, G-A044 4.73, G-A043 5.01, G-A048 4.77. Mean terrain is not saturation.
notes.residual_question: The total single-weight effect includes any curriculum-mediated change. This run cannot isolate the direct mechanism or generalize beyond training seed 42; no curriculum code changes are proposed.
notes.relation_to_v10: The frozen v10 seed pair (G-A045/G-A046) is not touched. A training-seed replicate needs U2 and a fresh unused number; it and this arm never share a server session.

lin_vel_z_l2.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:76]

walk_margin.reason: Two situation cells are negative at -1.375 (sway, push) while climb and walk are positive - the same shape as -1.25. At -1.25 the sheet predicted losses on sway and all four push directions and every one came out a gain, so the cells are carried as a record. The losing axes are guarded anyway: rough as the target and a hypothesis indicator, all four push directions in the protection block, all filmed. The generated base-data snapshot predates G-A049 (-1.0).

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 lin_vel_z_l2 (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py) pays -w * v_z^2 measured in the body frame. The square has no sign and the frame has no direction term, so rising onto a tread and bouncing after a bad landing are charged by the same expression; the weight is the only thing that separates how much either costs.

rows.reads: the best measured G3 point of this dial: G3 bound by rough_lateral seed 202 survival 0.75; 15 cm and 10 cm stairs posture falls 93 and 30 against baseline 90 and 34, inside the g3_guard_margin_v1 limits.
the other G3 point: rough_lateral seed 202 survival 0.65625 - and in the same run the cost G-A048 did not show: combined_yaw_right falls 29 and G2 4.58.
rough side-step posture falls 59 -> 16 at -1.25 and 59 -> 24 at -1.5 (the G-A043 row): the direct evidence that this interval moves G3 on this baseline.

the frozen baseline this arm starts from carries this dial at -2.0, walks (POLICY_LOCOMOTES) and scores 42.52861/70 over 69 cases with terrain level 4.7087 at iteration 999. G-A043's harvest adds the second walking value of this dial and is not yet in this ledger file.

contradicting.reads: the midpoint of -2.0 and -1.5 was worse than both ends on the fall counters: rough side-step 59 -> 80, push 22 -> 66, total 42.52861 -> 38.89379. A midpoint does not inherit its neighbours' performance.

one interval beyond -1.25 the G3 gain collapsed (rough_lateral seed 202 survival 0.40625, G3 4.59) - the G3 response to this dial is sharp, so a value between two good points is not assured to stay good.
the total is non-monotone across the four measured values (42.5286 / 38.8938 / 44.6245 / 50.1566), as is every counter in the same file. No trend is extrapolated to -1.0.
at -1.5 the combined right turn fell (29/96) and G2 dropped 9.21 -> 4.58, failing fact_rules_v1; the candidate sits between this point and one without the cost.

inference.singularity: One dial, five measured walking values on one baseline, every counter non-monotone: G3 rose only at -1.5 and -1.25 (7.41, 8.98) and collapsed at -1.75 and -1.0 (1.41, 4.59); the combined right-turn cost appeared only at -1.5. Whether G3 stays high between the two good points is unmeasured.

walk.basis: spec_margin at -1.375: walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.151, zone WALK, about ten times the stop zone's top +0.0155. Every measured value of this dial walked. That does not rule out a standing policy at the new value; the runner's stationary gate (G1:forward_nominal:101) checks it, and the arithmetic supports nothing else.

climb.basis: 15 cm ge2 was 0 / 0 / 77 / 24 / 1 across the five measured values. No direction is claimed; the stairs are protection cases in adoption.

sway.basis: rough side-step falls were 59 / 80 / 24 / 16 / 46; the arithmetic cell got the direction wrong at -1.5 and -1.25. No direction is claimed; the hypothesis indicator reads it.

push.basis: four-direction push falls were non-monotone (22 / 66 / 10 / 1 / 11). No direction is claimed; all four directions stay in the protection block.

inference.falsified_if: Hypothesis (tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py, thresholds fixed in preregistered.hypothesis): refuted if rough side-step posture falls are 59 or more; 42-58 is INSUFFICIENT, not near-support. The yaw cost is recorded: present at two or more seeds with a posture fall, absent at none. Adoption is separate: fact_rules_v1 plus g3_guard_margin_v1. A refuted hypothesis closes the single-term lin_vel_z search; it does not make G-A048's result luck.
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the exploratory hypothesis at this value on this path; it does not fix a lever effect (reports/GO2_SEED_SENSITIVITY.md section 5). The replicate waits on U2.
inference.status_reason: INFORMATION_RUN: -1.375 is between two measured points, every counter of this dial is non-monotone across five measured points (A044 is a midpoint counterexample), and the forecast sheet got most directions backwards at -1.25. The run tests a G3 target position; it does not recommend a value.
inference.counterevidence_response: The adverse rows change the design, not just the notes: A049's collapse closes outward relaxation, so the value stays between the two G3 points; A044's midpoint failure is why no midpoint performance is claimed and all 69 cases are collected; A043's yaw cost keeps both combined-turn directions filmed and G2 judged by fact_rules_v1; the stairs, no longer a target, stay as margin-protected cases rather than being dropped.
